scenes.incoming: Quarterly wage accounts are due; Dorrik has died.
scenes.turn: A seized ledger contains a concealed entry; Ilva gives Ragna a fragment.
scenes.outgoing: The ledger is in Harrow’s possession; Ragna has a clue linking a transaction to Dorrik’s death.

scenes.incoming: Wages unavailable; Ragna has the fragment and a suspected duplicate charge.
scenes.turn: Sella and Neri dispute the delivery and make their own arrangements; Sella keeps the original fragment.
scenes.outgoing: Only twenty bars reached their household although Dorrik signed for forty; Ragna and Neri plan a legitimate visit to Blackwater.

scenes.incoming: Ragna and Neri travel to Blackwater on a latch commission.
scenes.turn: Hessa shows records of two twenty-bar releases; Brann directs attention to a dismantled rail. Pell seizes Ragna’s notes.
scenes.outgoing: Neri and Ragna reconstruct their sketch; the works are restricted; Brann and his sister risk jobs and housing.

scenes.incoming: Blackwater investigation restricted; household finances in crisis.
scenes.turn: Merrok offers conditional relief; Ragna brings it to affected households, while Brann and sister move out of employer housing.
scenes.outgoing: A weigh-house meeting is set for two after Dorrik’s burial; Tavin proposes mutual relief; reserve payments require two partner signatures.

scenes.incoming: Burial and meeting; offer and mutual relief proposed.
scenes.turn: Four households take Merrok’s conditional payment; others set up a limited mutual fund and two petitions.
scenes.outgoing: Sella, Fenn and Vessa oversee two-day food/fuel relief; Brann signs only what he witnessed; separate bank and Ministry petitions await delivery.

scenes.incoming: Petitions ready; mutual relief temporarily functioning.
scenes.turn: Ilva admits directing concealment and introduces Venn, who admits changing a destination.
scenes.outgoing: Sella and Ragna each have attested copies showing twenty bars redirected; Venn retains original; Ilva will meet them next morning.

scenes.incoming: Ilva has agreed to explain the concealed reconciliation.
scenes.turn: Ilva admits certifying an advance and checking a transfer, and provides corroborating records; Ragna proposes a reserve advance against verified net wages.
scenes.outgoing: Ilva retains the control book; Sella and Ragna have signed copies. Partner Issa is present and Halrik expected; Edda seeks aid for her unregistered aunt.

scenes.incoming: Venn must decide how to testify; reserve request pending.
scenes.turn: Venn’s mother chooses to move; Venn authorises limited disclosure; Harrow refuses an independent hearing and Merrok suspends Ragna.
scenes.outgoing: Issa will examine balances with Halrik; Arven retains originals and certifies copies; Neri records an independent statement about the rail.

scenes.incoming: Community weighs disclosure and reserve request.
scenes.turn: Tavin circulates the agreed abstract before the agreed time; Harrow and Pell arrive to take Venn.
scenes.outgoing: Venn stands in the weigh house with the original dispatch; Harrow demands he accompany officials; Tavin stands by the latch as people gather.

scenes.incoming: Harrow demands Venn accompany officials; Tavin waits by the latch.
scenes.turn: A clearing spell and additional force cause injuries; Tavin is bound after helping Fenn.
scenes.outgoing: Harrow takes Venn, Tavin and original dispatch toward Blackwater; Fenn’s wrist is injured, and Ragna goes to tell Tavin’s mother.

scenes.incoming: Tavin and Venn taken; injuries need care.
scenes.turn: Hedra and Ragna obtain Pell’s written confirmation of detention but cannot see the prisoners; witnesses set terms for their evidence.
scenes.outgoing: Both detainees confirmed at Blackwater; fund cannot yet pay medical bills; partners will be asked to examine balances at Sella’s workshop.

scenes.incoming: Partners examine reconstructed records; Tavin and Venn remain detained.
scenes.turn: Issa and Halrik authorise and pay three verified balances, preserving other claims; Merrok offers Ragna a narrow private settlement.
scenes.outgoing: Issa has Ilva’s control book and issued a receipt; Sella’s iron account remains disputed. Ragna and Neri plan to approach the supplier.

scenes.incoming: Ragna and Neri seek the supplier’s record of forty bars.
scenes.turn: Mere confirms bank payment and Blackwater acceptance; she authorises the two to collect a damaged cart at Thorn.
scenes.outgoing: Ragna holds attested supplier records; the pair have a limited legitimate entry to Thorn tomorrow; a checkpoint hints at wider unrest.

scenes.incoming: Ragna and Neri have authority to collect Mere’s cart at Thorn.
scenes.turn: They find Kelm held at the depot; he wants to leave and carries a receiving counterfoil for the later forty.
scenes.outgoing: Cart repairs under way; Kelm remains at Thorn; both exits guarded and no counterfoil yet transferred.

scenes.incoming: Kelm wants to leave Thorn; Ragna and Neri have the cart.
scenes.turn: Kelm gives the forty-bar counterfoil and admits he removed the rail. They attempt to leave; Neri is injured and the cart and tools are abandoned.
scenes.outgoing: Ragna and Neri wait at the kiln; Kelm goes for help voluntarily; Ragna has the forty counterfoil. Venn and Tavin remain detained.

scenes.incoming: Neri injured at the kiln; Kelm has gone for help.
scenes.turn: Kelm returns with help and gives a detailed, signed account of the rail and Dorrik’s fall.
scenes.outgoing: Neri is in healer’s care; Mere will seek cart hire reimbursement; Sella holds the counterfoil and has heard Kelm’s account.

scenes.incoming: Tavin and Venn detained; Kelm has signed an account.
scenes.turn: Harrow offers Tavin’s and Venn’s release for the counterfoil and Ilva’s silence; Tavin refuses to have a deal made for him.
scenes.outgoing: The detainees remain held; Hedra knows the terms and has news of her son.

scenes.incoming: Sella’s first twenty-bar deduction still disputed; records remain at risk.
scenes.turn: Borr signs an account of carrying twenty bars to Thorn; Issa receives an order to surrender reserve records.
scenes.outgoing: Issa will discuss a Sella payment with Halrik; reserve records face seizure at noon tomorrow.

scenes.incoming: Reserve records face seizure; detainees held.
scenes.turn: Workers decide which specific work to withhold; partners pay an initial Sella balance.
scenes.outgoing: Carts wait, counterfoil custody changes to Mere, the bank records await transfer.

scenes.incoming: Officials arrive to take reserve records; workers withhold selected work.
scenes.turn: Harrow burns the ledger; Ilva and Ragna save fragments, and Vale intervenes.
scenes.outgoing: Partial reconciliation survives, records sealed at bank pending count; release of detainees still pending.

scenes.incoming: Partly burned records, testimony and counterfoil available.
scenes.turn: Merrok admits the posting; partners sign corrected wages and remove his signing authority; Vale orders detainees brought out.
scenes.outgoing: Tavin and Venn free pending inquiry; disputed wages authorised; records still under order.

scenes.incoming: Local settlement achieved; injuries, records and inquiry remain.
scenes.turn: Workers receive money; Neri hears Kelm’s account; Sella chooses a public notice; witnesses consent to a limited account.
scenes.outgoing: Ragna’s bank employment ends; open claims and wider rebellion remain for future stories.
